<!-- Step 4: the final model report and the exported assessment index for {{SPECIES_NAME}}.
Modelled on ref-assessment-index/docs/benchmark/beaked. Produces MULTIPLE indices (total
biomass, over-X-cm biomass, length-group abundances) and, via the *-section.qmd includes,
optional mesh / barrier / retro / CV / survey-comparison analyses (each behind a toggle). Set
bias_correct: true for the final run. Do NOT hard-wrap prose. -->

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
source(here::here("R", "00_setup.R"))
dt <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "compiled-data.rds")) |>
  dplyr::rename(lon = longitudestart, lat = latitudestart, year = startyear) |>
  dplyr::mutate(month = as.integer(month))
dt   <- sdmTMB::add_utm_columns(dt, ll_names = c("lon", "lat"), utm_crs = dt_crs)
grid <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "prediction-grid.rds"))
mesh <- sdmTMB::make_mesh(dt, xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), cutoff = cfg$MESH_CUTOFF_KM)
has_multiple_gears <- dplyr::n_distinct(dt$geartype) > 1
```

## Products

This report builds the indices the assessment needs. Define the response for each product;
`get_index_split()` computes many indices from one fit efficiently.

- **Total biomass** — `spatiotemporal = "ar1"`, no year effect.
- **Over-`r cfg$OVER_CM` cm biomass** — biomass of individuals above the threshold.
- **Length-group abundance** — one index per group in `config.yaml` `LENGTH_GROUPS`.
- **Selected assessment index** — `r cfg$SELECTED_INDEX` (feeds `r cfg$ASSESSMENT_MODEL`);
  often `iid` + `year` as a fixed effect. Confirm with the assessment lead.

```{r fit-products, eval=params$refit_models}
# Fit the total-biomass model (and length-based variants as needed). Example (total):
form <- build_formula(cfg, has_multiple_gears)
dt$value <- dt$rho_biomass
fit_total <- sdmTMB::sdmTMB(
  form, data = dplyr::filter(dt, !is.na(value)), mesh = mesh,
  family = model_family, spatial = "on", spatiotemporal = "ar1", time = "year",
  control = sdmTMB::sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 2)
)
saveRDS(fit_total, file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))
# … fit over-X-cm and per-length-group models similarly (adapt the response per product).
```

```{r load-products, eval=!params$refit_models}
fit_total <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))
```

## Indices

```{r indices}
pred_total  <- predict(fit_total, newdata = grid, return_tmb_object = TRUE)
index_total <- sdmTMB::get_index(pred_total, bias_correct = params$bias_correct,
                                 area = grid_cell_area_nmi2)
saveRDS(index_total, file.path(out_dir, "index-total.rds"))

ggplot2::ggplot(index_total, ggplot2::aes(year, est)) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Total biomass index")
```

## Results

```{r results}
plot_fixed_effects(fit_total)
plot_prediction_map(pred_total, crs = dt_crs, column = "est", type = "annual")
plot_random_field(pred_total, crs = dt_crs, field = "epsilon")
plot_residual_qq(fit_total)
```

## Export the assessment index

```{r export}
# Export the SELECTED index in the shape the assessment consumes.
selected <- index_total   # <- replace with the product named in cfg$SELECTED_INDEX
saveRDS(dplyr::select(selected, year, est, lwr, upr, se),
        file.path(out_dir, paste0("{{SPECIES_SLUG}}-assessment-index.rds")))
```
